story_fr: Nordson a publié des ventes record au T2 FY2026 de 741 millions de dollars, en hausse de 8 % sur un an, portees par une croissance organique de 7 % dans tous les segments.
story_en: Nordson posted record Q2 FY2026 sales of $741M, up 8% YoY, driven by 7% organic growth across all segments.
signal: Ventes T2 record : +8 % sur un an
quote: Sales were a second quarter record of $741 million, an increase of 8% year-over-year

story_fr: Le BPA ajuste de Nordson a atteint un niveau record de 2,86 dollars au T2 FY2026, en hausse de 18 % sur un an, refletant l'excellence operationnelle de la strategie Ascend.
story_en: Nordson's adjusted EPS hit a record $2.86 in Q2 FY2026, up 18% YoY, reflecting operational excellence under the Ascend strategy.
signal: BPA ajuste record T2 : +18 % sur un an
quote: Adjusted earnings per diluted share were a record $2.86, an 18% increase from the prior year

story_fr: Le carnet de commandes de Nordson a progresse de 18 % par rapport a l'annee precedente, signalant une demande soutenue et une visibilite solide pour les trimestres a venir.
story_en: Nordson's backlog grew 18% year-over-year, signaling sustained demand and strong forward visibility.
signal: Carnet de commandes +18 % sur un an
quote: Continued strength in demand with backlog up 18% compared to prior year

story_fr: Nordson a releve sa guidance annuelle FY2026 : ventes attendues entre 2 930 et 3 010 millions de dollars, et BPA ajuste entre 11,30 et 11,80 dollars par action.
story_en: Nordson raised its full-year FY2026 guidance: sales expected at $2,930-$3,010M and adjusted EPS at $11.30-$11.80.
signal: Guidance FY2026 relevee a la hausse
quote: Sales are now expected to be in the range of $2,930 to $3,010 million and adjusted earnings to be in the range of $11.30 to $11.80

story_fr: Le segment Advanced Technology Solutions a enregistre une croissance organique de 8 % au T2 FY2026, avec un EBITDA en hausse de 22 %, grace a la forte demande en systemes de distribution electronique.
story_en: The Advanced Technology Solutions segment posted 8% organic growth in Q2 FY2026 with EBITDA up 22%, driven by strong demand for electronics dispense systems.
quote: Record quarterly Advanced Technology Solutions sales of $178 million increased 10%...organic sales increase of 8%

story_fr: Nordson a acquis CapstanAG Systems en mars 2026, un specialiste de l'agriculture de precision en Amerique du Nord, pour renforcer sa presence aupres des OEM de niveau intermediaire.
story_en: Nordson acquired CapstanAG Systems in March 2026, a North American precision agriculture specialist, expanding its reach with mid-tier OEMs.
quote: The Company acquired CapstanAG Systems, a precision agriculture company in North America that is a complementary bolt-on
